verdict.rationale: AgentMail documents an official CLI on its own docs site at /integrations/cli. The docs say it creates inboxes, sends messages and manages threads without writing code, and ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies; a probe confirms the CLI page exists. The evidence covers only a short summary of the CLI. Missing for 10: a detailed command reference and evidence of AI-native features such as agent-friendly or JSON output, plus independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI

citations.quote: Create inboxes, send messages, manage threads, and more — all without writing code. It ships as a single native binary with no runtime dependencies.
